components.name: Module Band and Tab
components.description: Signature move. Gray band under a hairline top rule; a red numbered tab hangs flush from the rule with the title on its baseline.
components.css: .ds-band { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px 8px; background: #F2F2F2; border-top: 1px solid #E0E0E0; color: #111111; } .ds-tab { background: #E60012; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; padding: 2px 6px; } .ds-band-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Stats Table
components.description: A stage module's ruled table: L/M/R columns split by hairlines, the mean row set as a bold 22sp price numeral.
components.css: .ds-stats { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111111; } .ds-stats tr { border-bottom: 1px solid #E0E0E0; } .ds-stats tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-stats th { text-align: left; font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; color: #6B6B6B; padding: 2px 8px 2px 12px; } .ds-stats td { text-align: right; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; padding: 2px 8px; border-left: 1px solid #E0E0E0; } .ds-stats td:first-child { border-left: none; } .ds-stats td:last-child { padding-right: 12px; } .ds-head td { font-size: 12px; color: #6B6B6B; padding: 4px 8px; } .ds-mean th { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; padding: 4px 8px 4px 12px; } .ds-mean td { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; padding: 4px 8px; } .ds-stats td:hover { background: rgba(17,17,17,0.04); }

components.name: Run Row
components.description: Dense ruled row: run number, time, and edited tag on the left; a 3x3 score block on the right.
components.css: .ds-run { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; padding: 8px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111111; border-bottom: 1px solid #E0E0E0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-run:hover { background: #FAFAFA; } .ds-run-meta { flex: 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-run-meta b { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-run-meta span { font-size: 12px; color: #6B6B6B; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-run-scores { flex: 5; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; text-align: right; } .ds-run-meta .ds-edited { margin-top: 4px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid #E60012; color: #E60012; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Capture FAB
components.description: Extended red FAB that starts or stops capture; the only lifted element.
components.css: .ds-fab { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 56px; padding: 0 20px 0 16px; background: #E60012; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 2px 6px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:hover { background: #CC0010; } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Confirming action in dialogs and the run form (save, delete, create).
components.css: .ds-btn-filled { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; background: #E60012; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-filled:hover { background: #CC0010; } .ds-btn-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Dismissing action beside a filled button (cancel).
components.css: .ds-btn-text { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: #E60012; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-text:hover { background: rgba(230,0,18,0.08); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E60012; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dense filled score field with an outlined label; red 2px border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; position: relative; display: block; } .ds-field span { position: absolute; top: -7px; left: 8px; padding: 0 4px; background: #FFFFFF; font-size: 12px; color: #6B6B6B; } .ds-field input { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; width: 100%; padding: 10px; background: #F2F2F2; color: #111111; border: 1px solid #D6D6D6; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 16px; text-align: right; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border: 2px solid #E60012; padding: 9px; }

components.name: App Bar
components.description: Flat app bar on the white ground with an ink title and a hairline bottom rule.
components.html: Week 3 · Team A
components.css: .ds-appbar { font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111111; border-bottom: 1px solid #E0E0E0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Capture Bubble
components.description: The overlay's 56dp red circle that floats over the game.
components.css: .ds-bubble { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #E60012; color: #FFFFFF; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bubble:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
concapt reads like a page from a Japanese high-density reference site. Each session sits on white paper as ruled tables, the way a fare chart or a price list does. Nine means read at a glance from three stage modules that butt edge to edge. There are no floating cards, KPI tiles, or decorative fills. Density comes from hairline rules and tight leading, while text never drops below a legible size.

The world lends type, palette, density, and one signature move: a small red numbered tab hanging from the top rule of each module. Layout and controls stay standard Material 3. One theme, `buildTheme(Brightness)` in `lib/ui/theme.dart`, serves both Flutter engines (the main app and the capture overlay) in light and dark. Both schemes are fixed. There is no Dynamic Color, so pass/fail colors, the edited tag, and histogram markers look the same on every phone. Dark mode is designed in its own right, with a near-black warm ground, warm off-white ink, and a lifted red. It is not an inversion of light.

The user ruled out idol fan-site styling, bare-spreadsheet Material cards, fitness or finance KPI tiles, and long scrolling. The wiki is a reference for craft, not a template, so the app avoids tiny type and badge clutter.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink type, 1px hairline rules, gray header bands
One utility red for tabs, the FAB, the bubble, the mean marker, and the edited tag
Modules flush edge to edge, square corners, no shadows on content
Roboto with tabular figures everywhere; means set bold and large like price numerals
Fixed light and dark schemes shared by both engines

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Utility red marks only the things the player acts on or must find: tabs, the FAB, the bubble, the mean marker, and the edited tag. It never fills a surface or decorates.

rules.name: The Fixed Palette Rule
rules.body: Colors come from `colorScheme.*` only. No hard-coded colors, no Dynamic Color, and dark is its own designed scheme.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every text style carries `tnum`, so score columns line up digit for digit.

rules.name: The Price Numeral Rule
rules.body: The mean is the only number set at 22sp bold. Every other value stays at body size, so the mean row reads first.

rules.name: The 12sp Floor Rule
rules.body: Table rows never go below 12sp. Only histogram axis ticks use 11sp.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Content never casts a shadow. A new container gets a hairline or a band, not elevation.

dos: **Do** use `colorScheme.*` and `textTheme.*` for every color and text style.
**Do** open every new module with a `ModuleBand` and a red `ModuleTab`.
**Do** separate rows with 1px hairline-gray rules and keep modules flush edge to edge.
**Do** set the one number a screen is about in Mean Numeral and keep the rest at body size.
**Do** keep a 12dp gutter and the 2 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 16dp spacing steps.
**Do** design dark mode values deliberately when adding a role, never by inversion.
donts: **Don't** use elevated cards, KPI tiles, or shadows on content.
**Don't** use utility red as a fill for surfaces or decoration.
**Don't** round content containers; only controls get the 4dp corner.
**Don't** hard-code colors or font sizes, or put UI copy in Dart.
**Don't** add Dynamic Color or a third font weight.
